snippet.title: NAME OF THE WILL 集體後遺症 Gameplay Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
NAME OF THE WILL is a daylight horror narrative adventure. You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

你被困在 「希望」，一個以痛苦為救贖的愉悅邪教。在這裡，每種思想都被記錄，每個笑容都是謊言。選擇順從以換取幸福，或是直面你的罪咎，尋求逃脫。

Wishlist 加到願望清單：https://bit.ly/notwsteam 
Join Discord 加入 DC：https://discord.com/invite/4Zegfa5bS6
